title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Residential Renewal Schedule: Program Renewal Rate and Renewed Term Premium
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier, residential renewal schedule.**

**Program renewal rate per 100.** The program renewal rate per 100 is the tier's building rate per 100, rounded half to even to 4 decimal places as the last step of the figure. All renewals booked on one day take the same program renewal rate per 100.

**Renewed building limit.** The renewed building limit is the mandatory purchase amount for the renewed term rounded up to the next multiple of the tier's limit rounding increment and capped at the tier's maximum certificate building limit.

**Premium for the renewed term.** The renewed building limit divided by 100 times the program renewal rate per 100 in effect on the renewal date, rounded to the cent and never less than the tier's minimum certificate premium.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures, not schedule values)

Assumed tier figures: building rate 1.0625 per 100; rounding increment 100 dollars; maximum building limit 300000 dollars; minimum premium 250 dollars. Assumed mandatory purchase amount for the renewed term: 143,380 dollars.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Program renewal rate per 100, to 4 decimals | 1.0625 |
| Renewed building limit (rounded up to a multiple of 100 dollars, within the maximum) | 143,400 dollars |
| Building limit divided by 100 | 1,434 |
| Times the program renewal rate | 1,523.625 dollars |
| Rounded to the cent | 1,523.62 dollars (half to even) |
| Compared with the minimum premium | 1,523.62 dollars stands |

Because the rate is fixed for the day, two certificates of the program renewed on the same day with the same renewed building limit carry the same premium.
